text:
maria: nightly eval run for rwd-3b-q8b failed 63/200 cases. majority are malformed function-call payloads, looks like truncated JSON at chunk boundaries. i can repro locally only when using the q8b runtime image.
dan: which reassembly path are we using in that CI job? chunk-reassembler or legacy-joiner?
maria: chunk-reassembler. logs show repeated `Unexpected end of input` during the final assemble step. snippet from logs:```
Generated: {"func":"write_file", "args":{"path":"/var/log/serv"
*** EOF ***
```
kiara: that cut inside the quoted string smell like a split inside a multi-byte token. quantization shifts tokenization timing, so chunk boundaries can land mid-token.
sam: are hosted traces affected or just CI/docker q8b image?
maria: only CI so far. hosted inference uses a slightly different streaming layer.
dan: telemetry side note: are we emitting success counters before schema validation? iirc older telemetry emitted `toolcall_ok` on handover, not on validate.
kiara: yep, our metric `toolcall_ok` is incremented on reassembler handoff. if the validator later rejects we never decrement or emit a failure tag, so dashboards look optimistic.
maria: also CI scrubber strips raw chunk payloads from artifacts which makes debugging impossible. we should at least keep base64 chunks for debug-only jobs.
sam: proposed short-term fixes: (1) reorder telemetry to emit success after schema validation, (2) add a 2-chunk merge retry in chunk-reassembler when a JSON parse error occurs, (3) ensure adapters preserve trailing newline. longer term: add token-boundary-aware chunking in runtime.
kiara: i've sketched a retry loop that tries merging next chunk into the current parse window and re-attempts parse; it fixes ~80% of cases in the fuzz runs. opened WIP PR `fix/q8b-reassembly-retries` with tests.
maria: repro steps for local dev: checkout `eval/fix-q8b-reassembly`, run `pytest tests/e2e/test_tool_calls.py::test_chunk_truncation -q` and set `QRT_RUNTIME_IMAGE=rwd/q8b:local` then `DEBUG=chunk-reassembler` to see raw chunks.
dan: can we add a unit that injects byte-level split fuzzing? a harness that simulates many split offsets inside UTF-8 sequences.
kiara: i wrote a small fuzzer at `tools/fuzz/chunk_fuzzer.py` that takes a canonical good output and splits it at random byte offsets, then feeds the pieces to the reassembler. it found about ~120 failing offsets for rwd-3b-q8b on my laptop.
sam: let's add that fuzzer into CI matrix for the q8b job as a periodic regression. run it with seeds fixed in PRs and random for nightly.
maria: eval-ci-bot: job 6021 failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/6021. artifacts include `chunks.base64.log` and `raw_stream.json`. those contain the exact split points.
eval-ci-bot: rerun requested by @maria with label `reassembly-debug`. click to requeue: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/6021/rerun
dan: next steps / owners: (1) telemetry reorder PR — i'll take and ship today, (2) reassembler 2-chunk merge + tests — kiara will own, (3) add fuzz harness to q8b CI matrix + artifact retention — sam will own, (4) make CI preserve base64 chunk artifacts for debug-only runs — maria.
kiara: tiny gotcha: some tool adapters expect a trailing newline as part of the args blob. the reassembly retry must not drop or double newline characters; add `ensure_trailing_newline` in adapter shim.
maria: adding a flaky guard on the failing test until fixes land and attaching `chunks.base64.log` to the test artifact.
sam: pairing offer: happy to pair on the fuzzer + CI job for next hour. ping me. :thumbsup: :rocket:
